title: 3.2.4e Lab — random() colors
description: Spawn 5 Spheres at random positions, each with a random color built from random() values.

steps.title: Create 5 Spheres at random positions
steps.instructions: In setup(), use a for loop to create 5 Spheres. Pass `random(-5, 5)` for x and z, and a fixed y (like 0). Store them in an array.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the random() helper section.

steps.title: Give each sphere a random color
steps.instructions: Inside the loop, build a color string using random values for R, G, B channels: `'rgb(' + Math.floor(random(50,255)) + ',' + Math.floor(random(50,255)) + ',' + Math.floor(random(50,255)) + ')'`.
hints: Open the shplay docs drawer and check the color property section.

requirements.title: At least one Sphere is created
requirements.description: new Sphere() is called at least once.

requirements.title: Color is assigned to each sphere
